conventions.cosignature_v1: signature bytes = key_id(4) || uint64be(timestamp) || ed25519_sig(64) = 76 bytes; signed message = 'cosignature/v1\ntime <decimal ts>\n' || checkpoint note text (incl. final newline, excl. blank line and signatures)
conventions.key_id: SHA-256(key_name || 0x0A || sig_type || public_key)[:4], sig_type 0x01 = Ed25519 note signature, 0x04 = Ed25519 cosignature/v1, 0x06 = ML-DSA-44 subtree/v1 cosignature
conventions.leaf_data: Leaf data d[i] is the RAW 32 bytes of SHA-256(utf8('leaf-<i>')) (in EvidScope: the 32 bytes hex-decoded from ledger.hash). leaf_hash = SHA-256(0x00 || d[i]). node = SHA-256(0x01 || left || right). Empty tree root = SHA-256('').

description: C2SP signed-note / tlog-checkpoint / tlog-cosignature / tlog-witness test vectors for EvidScope. Generated by scratchpad/gointerop/vectors/main.go with golang.org/x/mod v0.41.0 (sumdb/note, sumdb/tlog) and cross-checked with filippo.io/torchwood v0.10.0 (litewitness library). All base64 is RFC 4648 standard alphabet WITH padding (canonical). All hex is lowercase.

mldsa44_cosignature.cosigned_subtree_layout: 'subtree/v1\n\0'(12) || u8 len || cosigner_name || u64be timestamp || u8 len || origin || u64be start(0) || u64be end(size) || root(32)
mldsa44_cosignature.note: OPTIONAL (future): litewitness keys come from ssh-agent and are Ed25519 only, so litewitness emits only type 0x04. ML-DSA-44 key from FIPS 204 seed; signature produced with SignDeterministic (empty context).

NOT_RECOMMENDED_hex_string_leaf_data.note: Same tree if d[i] were the 64-char lowercase ASCII hex string instead of raw bytes. Shown only to make the difference testable; do NOT use.

witness_requests.content_type_note: litewitness ignores request Content-Type; send text/plain. 200 responses are 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' (Go sniffing), 409 is 'text/x.tlog.size'.
